author: wout
title: Lead the pitch with the business case, make the connector a side note
body:
Feedback on the first deck: too focused on the MCP connector, and what
does a business leader gain in time and money. The story now opens with
time, risk and steering for whoever runs agentic payroll, with sourced
numbers and a labelled 23,000-hour scenario.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: arend
title: Knowledge graph as a shared Cloud Run service (#13)
body:
SQLite storage with one-time JSONL import and a GCS mirror, member tokens
for writes, row ids owned by their first writer, sessions grouped per
person, the full row shape, a FastAPI server, seed rows and tests.

title: Redesign the marketing page and add an end-to-end demo script
body:
The page now follows the HyperFrames launch films people shared: one
heavy type face, a cream and forest palette, motivated transitions.
demo/demo.sh creates a real Claude Code session, records it and pushes
the rows, ready to ask the Slack bot.

author: tristan
title: Add screenshot input, MCP server and a copy of Alberic's graph
body:
Screenshots of other AI chats are read by Claude into the same rows.
The MCP server lets Claude, VS Code or Copilot Studio ask who_knows and
record signals, with the person taken from the member token. The
knowledge_graph and proficiency packages are copied into vendor/ ahead
of moving the store onto them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: tristan
title: Add who-knows recorder, store and assistant access in ideas/tristan
body:
The recorder turns Claude Code sessions into rows per human turn
(decided, corrected, explained_why, accepted_as_is) with verbatim whys,
by backfill or a live Stop hook. A FastAPI + SQLite store ranks who
actually reasoned about a task. Answers come over MCP and a Socket Mode
Slack bot. Screenshots of other AI chats are read by Claude into the
same rows. Also adds the HyperFrames marketing page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
